name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for engines and a knack for fixing things, fostered in his father's garage in rural Wales. After completing his apprenticeship at a local engineering firm, he quickly gravitated towards the high-octane world of racing. His meticulous approach to fabrication, combined with a practical understanding of mechanical systems, makes him a valuable asset in the workshop.

Gareth is known for his innovative problem-solving skills, often devising unique solutions to improve performance and reliability. He is dedicated to his craft, committed to quality, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure the team's success. His quiet determination and loyalty have earned him the respect of his colleagues, who value his expertise and steady hand under pressure.

physical.description: A stocky man with a focused gaze and hands that bear the marks of years spent working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Drinks copious amounts of strong tea throughout the day.
Has a habit of humming quietly while welding.
